tutorials.title: How Waymark works
tutorials.summary: A one-minute tour: a guide plays on the page and moves on when you act.

steps.title: Welcome to the practice page
steps.note: This is a pretend invoicing app, made for practice. Waymark guides you through it one step at a time. Press **Next**.
steps.voiceText: Welcome to the practice page. This is a pretend invoicing app. Waymark guides you through it one step at a time. Press Next.

steps.title: Click **New invoice**
steps.note: The bright frame shows where to act. Click it yourself: the guide moves on when you do.

steps.title: Type a customer name
steps.note: Anything works. Waymark never saves what you type. Press **Next** when you’re done.

steps.title: The controls at the top of this box
steps.note: **Back** returns to the last step. The speaker mutes the voice, and **×** ends the guide. The keys Alt+. and Alt+, also go forward and back.

steps.title: That’s a guide
steps.note: Guides you record play just like this, on your own web app. Next, try **Record your first guide**.

tutorials.title: Record your first guide
tutorials.summary: Name it, press Record, do the task once, press Stop.

steps.title: Start in the Waymark side panel
steps.note: On your web app, click the Waymark icon in the toolbar (in Chrome it may be under the puzzle piece). On a site Waymark hasn’t seen, press **Allow on this site** first. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

steps.title: Name it, then press **Record**
steps.note: Use the name a learner would look for, like “Create an invoice”. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

steps.title: Now do the task once: click **New invoice**
steps.note: While recording, each click becomes a step. A red **REC** bar on the page shows the newest one.

steps.title: Choose the **payment terms**
steps.note: Lists and menus are recorded as “Choose” steps.

steps.title: What you type is never saved
steps.note: A step says “Enter Email”, never the email itself. Passwords and values stay on your device and out of the guide.

steps.title: Press **Stop** when you’re done
steps.note: The guide is saved and opens in the editor. This practice page can’t be recorded, so try it on your own app next. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

tutorials.title: Edit a guide
tutorials.summary: Titles, notes, spoken text, Test step and Re-pick.

steps.title: Each step is one line
steps.note: In the editor, click a step to open it. Use the arrows to reorder and the bin to delete; **Undo** brings a step back. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

steps.title: Title and note
steps.note: The title says what to do; the note says why or how. Learners read both in this box. Put two stars around words to make them **bold**. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

steps.title: Spoken text
steps.note: Under **More options**, write what the voice should say. Leave it empty, and Waymark reads the title and note. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)
steps.voiceText: Under More options, write what the voice should say. If you leave it empty, Waymark reads the title and the note.

steps.title: **Test step** and **Re-pick element**
steps.note: Test step looks for the element on the page right now. Re-pick lets you click the right element instead; that click doesn’t reach the app. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

steps.title: Try it: this step points at **Invoices**
steps.note: Imagine you recorded the wrong button. After a re-pick, the guide points here instead. Click **Invoices** to go on.

steps.title: Press **Save**
steps.note: Each save makes a new version. **Discard and close** throws away changes you haven’t saved. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

tutorials.title: Share a guide
tutorials.summary: Export a file, copy a link, import, and team libraries.

steps.title: Open a guide’s **⋯** menu
steps.note: Every guide in the list has Edit, ⋯ and Start. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

steps.title: **Share…** saves a guide file
steps.note: First you see every word the file will hold: remove anything private, like customer names. Choose a printable how-to for people who don’t use Waymark. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

steps.title: **Copy link** for one guide
steps.note: Send it in a chat. Someone with Waymark who opens it on the app is offered the guide. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

steps.title: **Import…** a file someone sent you
steps.note: Waymark shows what’s in it first, and asks to be allowed on the guide’s site if needed. (This is a picture: you do it in the real panel.)

steps.title: For a whole team: a team library
steps.note: Put an exported guide file at a web address. Everyone pastes that address in **Settings → Team library** and sees the same guides, kept up to date.

tutorials.title: What the warnings mean
tutorials.summary: Hard to find, Drawing area, and what happens when a step can’t be found.

steps.title: **Drawing area**
steps.note: Charts and maps have nothing inside them to point at. A click recorded here gets this warning. Add a note step that explains the chart instead.

steps.title: **Hard to find**
steps.note: This is plain text, not a button. A click on it may not be found next time. Re-pick the real button, or delete the step.

steps.title: **Not recorded**
steps.note: Some clicks have nothing Waymark could ever find again, like a long sentence. Then no step is added, and the REC bar says so.

steps.title: Click **Archive all**
steps.note: This button isn’t on the page, so you’ll see what Waymark does when it can’t find a step.

steps.title: Waymark never guesses
steps.note: When a step can’t be found, the learner can **Retry**, **Skip**, or **Report** it. Reports go to **Settings → Problems**, so you can fix the step with Re-pick.
